artifact: Per-pod / per-root val corpus inventory, by EPISODE COUNT and BYTE-LEVEL content, not by directory name
why: A prior finding recorded that the val corpus is deployed at 600 / 40 / 12 episodes under the SAME directory name, so a name-based or count-based assertion is not evidence. Every row below is keyed on sha256 of the raw poses bytes.

identity_key.why_rejected: MEASURED: episode_id COLLIDES. The parity train holds 2376 episodes but only 2342 unique episode_id values (34 collisions); the 600-ep clean val holds 600 episodes with 596 unique ids. Sample values (808464740, 808465461, ...) are a 4-character prefix of the clip_id packed as int32, so the key is lossy by construction and OVER-reports overlap.
identity_key.consequence: Any disjointness figure computed on episode_id is an upper bound, not a measurement. The 600-ep val shows 20/600 = 3.3% episode_id overlap with the parity train and 0/600 = 0.0% byte-level overlap: the 20 are key collisions, not leakage.

corrections_to_inherited_figures.claim: physicalai-val-f1b378f295ae is 78.5 % leaked into the parity train
corrections_to_inherited_figures.measured_here: 62 of 80 ep_*.pt files are byte-identical to parity-train episodes = 77.5 %. The SAME 62 episodes give 62/79 = 78.48 % if the denominator is the 79 UNIQUE episode_ids rather than the 80 files. The inherited 78.5 % used the 79 denominator.
corrections_to_inherited_figures.verdict: SUBSTANTIALLY CONFIRMED - the leak is real and the same 62 episodes; only the denominator differs. The split stays REFUSED.

corrections_to_inherited_figures.claim: S3's local caches overlap the parity corpus by 17.5 % (train) / 17.0 % (val)
corrections_to_inherited_figures.measured_here: BYTE-LEVEL overlap is 58/400 = 14.5 % and 14/100 = 14.0 %. The 17.5/17.0 figures were computed on episode_id, which collides.
corrections_to_inherited_figures.verdict: S3's caveat direction is right and its conclusion is unchanged (the caches are non-parity); the magnitude was over-stated by the colliding key.

corrections_to_inherited_figures.claim: the 600-episode physicalai-val-0c5f7dac3b11 lives 'on the training pods'
corrections_to_inherited_figures.measured_here: It exists on EXACTLY ONE host: pod2, /workspace/data/physicalai_phase0/_epcache/physicalai-val-0c5f7dac3b11, 600 ep_*.pt, 66 GB. pod1's _epcache root holds ONLY the parity train and no val dir at all; pod1's val is the 12-ep /root/valdata copy. pod3 has NO clean val at any path.
corrections_to_inherited_figures.verdict: The build EXISTS (S3's key claim stands) but 'the training pods' plural is wrong, and the pod that has it is the one pod that is off-limits. This is the operational core of the ceiling.
